deploy-bot: starting migration window for tenant_profiles schema at 2026-03-21T21:00Z (mig-2026-03-21-tnp). plan: ADD INDEX CONCURRENTLY ON profiles (lower(email)) + partial backfill for active_tenants. rolling canary 1% -> 10% -> 100%. estimated ~45m/region. /hold to pause.

Alice K: thanks. quick checks: are replicas caught up? any long-running queries to drain first? :eyes:

DB Oncall: replicas look healthy, replication lag < 200ms on main replicas in us-west1/us-east1. I'll watch. If lag > 3s we pause. Set alert on replica-lag >= 3s.

Ben T: we should pin web-worker to v2.14.1 for the rollout window — earlier releases read the old index name. Can ops set a deploy gate? If not, we'll see 500s on lookup path.

Carla M: confirmed preflight passed on staging. outputs:
```
CHECKS: indexes: none conflicting
ROWCOUNT SAMPLE: 120k rows in active_tenants shard
LOCKS: no conflicting exclusive locks
```
No schema drift.

Sam H: adding deploy gate: pin service:web-worker=2.14.1 for 1h. I'll annotate release notes and create a rollback play if we see >5% error rate or 15% drop in global RPS.

Maria L: request: please add a migration tag in the release notes and include the exact ALTER statement and canary timestamps. Also add contact for post-migration validation (qa @Maria L).

Alice K: operational criteria recap:
- abort if replica lag > 3s for >2min
- abort if 5xx rate increases >5 percentage points for 3 consecutive minutes
- abort if global RPS drops >15% and doesn't recover in 5m
- safe fallback: drop new index on failure (manual) and revert web-worker pin

Carla M: migration commands we'll run (concurrent index + small batch backfill):
```
-- run in replica-safe window
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_profiles_email_lower ON profiles (lower(email)) WHERE active_tenant = true;
-- backfill script (idempotent)
python infra/tools/backfill_index.py --table profiles --index idx_profiles_email_lower --batch-size 5000 --throttle 50
```

deploy-bot: preflight hook passed at 20:30Z, canary cutoff scheduled 21:10Z. deploy-bot will post roll/pause signals.

DB Oncall: I'll be oncall and watching slow query log + replication. Ping me in thread to escalate.

Ben T: noted. I'll freeze migrations on master branch after canary start, and tag release v2.14.1+dbmig. If we need rollback, we unpin and deploy previous app build.

Maria L: QA validation steps after index is ready:
- run the profile lookup perf script on a 10k sample
- sanity check counts for active_tenants by tenant_id
- run smoke on signup flow (10 requests/s for 2m)

Alice K: cool. Everyone react with :thumbsup: when ready. I'll start the migration at 21:00Z unless hold is requested.

Sam H: :thumbsup:

Carla M: :thumbsup:

DB Oncall: :thumbsup: monitoring in place.

deploy-bot: migration started at 21:00Z. canary at 21:05Z -> 1% traffic. status will post updates every 5m.

Alice K: keeping thread pinned for postmortem notes. If anything, use /hold now.

Ben T: ping if we need to escalate to rollback — I'll prepare the previous image.

Maria L: I'll run QA once canary reaches 10%.

-- end of thread --
